translations.web: But you, Yahweh, are a shield around me, my glory, and the one who lifts up my head.
translations.bsb: But You, O LORD, are a shield around me, my glory, and the One who lifts my head.
translations.kjv: But thou, O LORD, art a shield for me; my glory, and the lifter up of mine head.
translations.asv: But thou, O Jehovah, art a shield about me; My glory and the lifter up of my head.
